notes:
StreamForge 1.0 — broadcast graphics, multistream and a rebuilt app.

• Graphics packs: cricket, kabaddi and football scoreboards, lower third, headline bar, wedding title and logo bug
• Live scoring on the camera screen — tap +4 or Wicket without leaving the stream
• Scenes: switch between pre-show, live, break and outro instantly, even while live
• Multistream: publish to YouTube, Facebook and a custom RTMP server at the same time
• Rebuilt interface throughout, with light and dark themes
• Plans and licence activation are now built into the app
